lines.trans: The groom may kiss the bride.
Am I not late?
After all, a child needs a father.
He is not the father.
A husband has the right to know who the child's father is.
Tell him there is no such thing in the law.
You are already almost not my husband.
I am not going to report to you.
Who is the child's father?
It was your cook who dumped her!
From this moment I am taking her under my control.
I will look after the child myself.

lines.trans: See you soon!

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.en: to leave, to walk out on (someone)

examples.text: Меня жена бросила. Два пальца сломаны.
examples.trans: My wife has left me. Two of my fingers are broken.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: Man engaged or about to be married.

examples.trans: She has a rich suitor now.

examples.text: К жениху своему? Чего? Стоять, кому сказал! Иди сюда!
examples.trans: To her boyfriend's? What? Stop right there, I said! Come here!
This is the law of the country.

examples.text: Я помню все установленные законом правила.
examples.trans: I remember all the rules established by law.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

examples.text: Ты у Третьякова под личным контролем.

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: From Latin 'momentum' (movement, brief span of time).

examples.text: А мне что-то уже не хочется. Момент упущен.
examples.trans: Somehow I don't feel like it anymore. The moment has passed.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
Nina, pour your husband a drink. We've got something to celebrate!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Теперь мы станем настоящими женихом и невестой!
examples.trans: Now we will become real groom and bride!

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: + на: опоздать на работу = be late for work
fleeting е in all declined forms: отца, отцу...

examples.text: Твой отец когда-то назвал меня очкариком.
examples.trans: Your father once called me four-eyes.
My father works at a factory.

examples.text: Слушай, эти детские клички такие прилипчивые. Твой отец когда-то назвал меня очкариком.
examples.trans: Listen, these childhood nicknames really stick. Your father once called me four-eyes.

examples.text: Я не собираюсь перед тобой отчитываться.
examples.trans: I'm not going to answer to you.

examples.text: Каждый вечер повара отчитываются перед шефом.
examples.trans: Every evening the cooks report to the chef.
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
examples.trans: Don't hang up, I'm begging you! I'm on my knees in front of you.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.
The cat is under the table.

examples.text: Хорошо, давайте три. Под мою личную ответственность.
examples.trans: All right, let's say three. On my personal responsibility.

examples.text: Наш с вами город очень старый. Почти четыре века здесь были набеги.
examples.trans: Our town is very old. For almost four centuries there were raids here.
She had a right to the flat.

examples.text: Моя мама имела право на квартиру. Она пенсионерка.
examples.trans: My mother had a right to the flat. She is a pensioner.

проследить.gloss: to see to it, to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to keep an eye on, to make sure

examples.trans: We'll keep an eye on it.
I'll keep an eye on the children.
All right. My students and I will keep an eye on it.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

собираться.gloss: to intend, to be about to; to gather

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to

examples.text: Ну и что? Я всё равно переезжать собираюсь.
examples.trans: So what? I'm planning to move anyway.

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
